description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of framing types observed in narrative media related to political discourse. The chart contains four slices, representing “Right bias”, “Left bias”, “Questionable source”, and an unlabeled fourth category. The “Right bias” slice is blue and represents 30.0% (30) of the total. The “Left bias” slice is orange and represents 28.0% (28) of the total. The “Questionable source” slice is green and represents 22.0% (22) of the total. The final slice is red and represents 20.0% (20) of the total. Percentage labels and corresponding counts are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest proportion and decreasing in size. A legend is not present, but each slice is labeled directly on the chart.
